mission: Turn Buddy's original 211-style government navigator into a continuously refreshed government services, public-work, spending, needs and opportunity intelligence layer across federal, state, local, tribal, territorial and public-authority systems.

official_us_source_registry.purpose: official federal government information, benefits and service navigation
official_us_source_registry.runtime_claim: service facts must retain official source and freshness

official_us_source_registry.purpose: federal spending, award, agency and recipient intelligence
official_us_source_registry.auth: public API currently available without authorization
official_us_source_registry.runtime_claim: spending figures require fiscal period, accounting meaning, source and retrieval time
opportunity status/deadline must be refreshed from SAM.gov

official_us_source_registry.purpose: federal grant opportunity discovery and grant-system integration
official_us_source_registry.auth: some search access is public; other APIs may require credentials
official_us_source_registry.runtime_claim: grant opportunity status/deadline must be refreshed from Grants.gov

official_us_source_registry.purpose: agency-specific programs, forms, fees, policies, forecasts and services
official_us_source_registry.runtime_claim: agency source overrides generalized summaries for agency-specific rules

official_us_source_registry.purpose: non-federal programs, services, procurement, budgets, permits, licenses and public records
official_us_source_registry.runtime_claim: never infer one jurisdiction's rules from another

government_job_coverage_rule: Every discovered government department/job family/task receives an AI-assist benchmark, human-authority boundary, sandbox suite, productivity baseline, parallel gap worker and retest path.

watch_cadence.service_rules: daily or source-change aware where practical
watch_cadence.contracts: daily or more often within API limits

truth_rule: Buddy may navigate, research, organize, draft, benchmark and surface opportunities, but it is not a government agency and does not possess government authority. Current services, rules, spending, grants and contracts require authoritative runtime evidence.
